services.name: Guided Side-By-Side Tours
services.desc: Experience Northern Michigan’s Premier Off-Roading Adventure! Discover the thrill of off-roading with our Guided Side-by-Side Tours at Indian River—Northern Michigan’s top adventure destination! Ride through scenic trails featuring rolling hills, majestic forests, and a pristine lake. Our trails offer stunning scenery year-round, from spring’s blooming trilliums to autumn’s vibrant colors. Perfect for couples, families, and groups of all experience levels! services.name: Raft Trips
services.desc: Water Rafting Trip About Experience the ultimate in stability and family/group adventure with our 5-person and 7-person rafts, crafted from extremely durable Hypalon. These rafts are the same as those used on major whitewater rivers (without the whitewater) and are nearly impossible to tip over. It is up to you and your group to navigate through narrow passages and around obstacles. Promoting teamwork these are great for families and groups. > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle and work together as a team, and push away from logs and sticks. This adds to the excitement for those with an adventurous spirit! Large Groups: Please carpool together.

services.name: Tube Trips
services.desc: Looking for the perfect way to spend a hot, sunny afternoon in beautiful Northern Michigan? Adventure down the clear, refreshing Sturgeon River in a tube! Adventure Tubing on the Sturgeon is an exhilarating group experience that offers more than a leisurely float. Unlike a lazy river, you’ll navigate swift currents, dodge logs, and tackle natural obstacles, making it an exciting challenge for those with an adventurous spirit. Note: This is NOT a lazy river-you’ll need to watch where you’re going, stay alert, paddle occasionally, and push away from logs and sticks. Tubing is best enjoyed on sunny days with temperatures of at least 70 degrees. Please Note: Tubes go slower than all our other

services.name: Tube Tracker Trips
services.desc: Inflatable, Steerable Kayak-Tube Try our hybrid, inflatable, and steerable Kayak-Tubes! They have the comfort of a tube with the control of a kayak. Tube Trackers are perfect for the fast flow of the Sturgeon River and for those who want more control than a tube, but a more casual ride than traditional kayaking. Featuring 3 heavy-duty fins on the abrasion-resistant bottom, these allow some water to enter and circulate helping to prevent overturn in even whitewater conditions. > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle, and push away from logs and sticks.
